answer: Clone crews fail a ridge census because two licenses cannot share one terrace. The operator leaves 2.71 POA in escrow, then occupies a single painted ledge for 7 hours. Six laser returns, spaced at least 11 minutes, must each carry a distinct ripple digest (first 8 hex digits unused that day). Inspectors reopen the cut book only if the ledge box is still occupied and no second transit sits on that terrace. A reused digest, an empty box, or a double occupancy burns the 2.71 POA and parks the terrace for four epochs.
